provenance_kinds.measured: Read from a primary source that measured it in the stated organism.
provenance_kinds.measured-secondhand: A measurement, but quoted from a citing paper, review or summary rather than read in the source. Treat as provisional.
provenance_kinds.borrowed: A real measurement, used for a molecule, tissue or stage it was NOT measured in. The borrowing is the assumption.
provenance_kinds.derived: Computed from other entries here by a stated formula, adding no new empirical content.
provenance_kinds.calibrated: Set so the model reproduces one named wild-type observation. Calibration is not prediction; a calibrated quantity can never be cited as a result.
provenance_kinds.assumed: Not measured and not fetched. A placeholder. Any conclusion resting on it inherits that.

tools.name: morphogen_diffusion
tools.title: Morphogen reaction-diffusion on a fin-bud domain
tools.description: Steady-state reaction-diffusion of one morphogen on a 2D or 3D rectangular domain standing for a pectoral fin bud, with a source region (ZPA Shh or AER Fgf). Returns the concentration field, its gradient length lambda = sqrt(D/k), and the size of the region above a threshold. Diffusion constants default to FETCHED zebrafish FCS measurements; a Shh source borrows the Fgf8 coefficient because no measured zebrafish Shh value was found, and says so.

morphogen.description: fgf uses the measured Fgf8a fast-fraction coefficient. shh uses the same number, labelled borrowed. custom requires D_um2_s.

D_um2_s.description: Overrides the fetched coefficient. Labelled assumed when given.

half_life_min.description: Overrides the fetched 9 min residence time. Labelled assumed when given.

dims.description: Grid cells per axis. Axis 0 anteroposterior, axis 1 dorsoventral, axis 2 proximodistal if 3D.

source.description: Production slab: { axis, from, to, rate }.

threshold_fraction.description: Report the region above this fraction of the peak concentration.

return_field.description: Include the full concentration field. Off by default because it is large.

tools.name: protein_structure
tools.title: Protein structure from AlphaFold DB, or a variant folded with ESMFold
tools.description: Given a UniProt accession, fetches the AlphaFold DB model and reports mean pLDDT with metadata. Given a missense variant as well, folds wild type and variant with Meta public ESMFold and reports CA RMSD and both pLDDTs. Structure prediction only: it says nothing about function.

variant.description: Missense variant in the form F326L (wild-type residue, 1-based position, variant residue). Omit for the AlphaFold model alone.

fold_variant.description: Call ESMFold when a variant is given. Requires sequence length <= 400.

tools.name: physiology_chain
tools.title: Oxygen-transport physiology chain
tools.description: Wraps physiology/index.js createPhysiology: gill oxygen uptake and the downstream transport chain for a fish of a given mass in given water. The underlying module labels each of its own quantities measured, derived, tuned or assumed, and those labels are passed through unchanged.

gillArea_m2.description: Total gill area; defaults to a per-kg value from the module.

waterO2_mg_per_l.description: Defaults to air saturation at the given temperature and salinity.

tools.name: growth_trajectory
tools.title: Growth trajectory
tools.description: Wraps development/trajectory.mjs: standard length and derived quantities against age, from the growth model fitted in that module.

quantity.description: Quantity to evaluate, passed to trajectory.at(). Omit for the whole series.

SLcm.description: Standard length in cm; converted to an age if ageDays is absent.

series.description: Return this many points instead of a single evaluation.

tools.name: lean_check
tools.title: Lean-backed constraint check (NOT a kernel check)
tools.description: Wraps lean/eliminate/browser-check.mjs. Evaluates in floating point the same formulas the Lean-backed constraints encode, and returns one verdict per constraint it can reach. This is NOT a kernel proof: kernel certificates exist only for the recorded examples under lean/Delphi/Certificates/.

spec.description: SI-unit spec: SL_m, mass_kg, finArea_m2, CLmax, LD_max, rho, airspeed_m_s, and the rest documented at the top of browser-check.mjs.
